props.source: real (OSM highway=stop node on columbia_ave_east, 35 ft from the junction): a surveyed control node, so WHICH approach is controlled and how far out is real data, not a guess. Approximation: the lateral side is derived (approaching driver's right) and the sign is set 3 ft back from the curb - the node itself sits on the road centerline and says nothing about either.
